annotation.bound_parties_text: The Plan directs the Shanghai Municipality (municipal government) to support, fund and establish platforms, frameworks and mechanisms for the embodied intelligence industry.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: this Municipality shall organize scenario solicitation and task-based bidding to explore new models of embodied intelligence application.
annotation.dates_quote: This Plan shall be effective as of July 28, 2025, and shall remain in effect until July 27, 2028.
annotation.robot_provision_quote: Implementation Plan of Shanghai Municipality for the Development of the Embodied Intelligence Industry
